issues.evidence: LAN client streams on 2.1.0-alpha5 (3 runs): the old TCP connection stalled for 20-21 s and then broke instead of resuming; applications see up to ~40 s until they reconnect.
issues.idea: After a committed switch the router could drop stale conntrack entries of the old tunnel so clients reconnect at once.
issues.title_en: Existing TCP connections hang ~40 s on failover
issues.title_ru: Старые TCP-соединения висят ~40 с при переключении

issues.evidence: LAN client killmid run on 2.1.0-alpha5: LAN stall 128.2 s; soak kill-auto-mid traffic moved after a median of ~91 s.
issues.idea: Resume or roll back the interrupted transaction right after the supervisor restarts instead of waiting for a full re-confirmation.
issues.title_en: Recovery after the Auto process is killed mid-switch takes ~128 s
issues.title_ru: Восстановление после убийства Auto посреди переключения ~128 с

issues.evidence: Phase 2 pass 1 (2.1.0-alpha5): primary-blip-15 switched after 20 s although the primary was already back.
issues.idea: Re-check the primary right before APPLYING and cancel when it has recovered.
issues.title_en: A 15 s blackout gives an unnecessary late switch
issues.title_ru: Обрыв 15 с даёт ненужное позднее переключение

issues.evidence: Phase 2: primary-mtu (packets over 1300 bytes dropped) passed unnoticed; probes use small packets.
issues.idea: Add a large-packet (PMTU) probe to the confirmation step.
issues.title_en: MTU black hole is not detected

issues.evidence: Phase 2: netem loss 10 % switched, 20 % and 30 % did not; older soaks: primary-loss 30 % switched in 9 of 15.
issues.idea: Write the threshold into the specification and use a loss-rate window instead of consecutive failures.

issues.evidence: Analysis 02.11: the real reserve error code appears after a median of 7.8 s; the report measured a different event.
issues.idea: Fixed in the report: detection is taken from the reserve's own error code.

issues.evidence: LAN client 01.11 on 2.0.0-alpha26: dns_stall 90.1 s; cause: GL dns_mark kernel rule order.
issues.idea: Fixed in 2.0.0-beta3/beta4: the active tunnel mark is written into every rule; LAN DNS stall 19.9 s afterwards.
issues.title_en: DNS stall 90 s while traffic stalled 40 s
issues.title_ru: DNS-простой 90 с при простое трафика 40 с

matrix.note: netem works on the MT3000; new fault kinds (https, mtu, flap, wan, carrying, server-port, pause, clock-jump) set and remove themselves; P95/max in the soak report.
matrix.title_en: Tools: netem and new fault kinds
matrix.title_ru: Инструменты: netem и новые виды сбоев

matrix.note: 0 leaked packets in every LAN client run; IPv6 read-only check passed (no v6 upstream, guard drops v6). Open: boot-window leak counter, IPv6 at a provider that offers it.
Pass 1 of 5: 20 cycles, 18 matched the provisional spec. Blackout 15 s switched late; loss 10 % switched, 20-30 % did not.
2 series run on 2.1.0-alpha5; the long flap found the switch limit leaving a dead primary (fixed in 2.1.0-alpha6, not yet re-run on the router).
5 of 5 cycles OK (wan-drop 60/300 s, reserve-drop-carrying, server-drop, server-port-drop). Open: WAN address change.
LAN client streams: old TCP connection stalls ~20 s and breaks; DNS stall ~20 s (was 90 s before 2.0.0-beta3/beta4).
pause-auto 30/120 s and clock jump OK on 2.1.0-alpha4. Open: /tmp filled to 95 %.
Longest run so far ~10 h (174 cycles, 0 real failures) without a continuous LAN client.
5 of 5 physical power cuts and all sysrq-b reboots recovered by themselves. Open: cut right after a journal write and during opkg install.
